subject.title: fix(daemon): refuse duplicate launchd gateway managers

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrow fail-closed rule that a loaded same-label system job or canonical system plist blocks all user LaunchAgent creation and activation?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and well-proven, but it intentionally changes existing externally managed or stale-system-plist workflows into an operator-visible stop requiring privileged cleanup; repository policy treats that compatibility boundary as a maintainer-owned decision.

options.title: Accept Narrow Guard
options.body: Merge this canonical duplicate-manager fix now and keep first-class system LaunchDaemon lifecycle support explicitly out of scope.

options.title: Require Unified Lifecycle
options.body: Pause the PR until user-domain and system-domain launchd ownership, status, cleanup, and migration behavior have one shared product contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Guard
recommendation.body: Merge this canonical duplicate-manager fix now and keep first-class system LaunchDaemon lifecycle support explicitly out of scope.
